title: 2024 Bowman - #39 Sal Frelick (RC) - Brewers
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a highly sought-after 2024 Bowman sports trading card featuring Sal Frelick, a rookie player for the Milwaukee Brewers in Major League Baseball (MLB). The card is part of the base set and has a card number of 39. It is perfect for any baseball fan or collector looking to add a valuable piece to their collection. The card is manufactured by Topps and is from the 2024 season.
